purpose: Independent identical checks of completed pilot arms; no optimizer score as truth.

rules_skipped.must_lock: the intent declares no must_lock patterns

assembly.coincident_origins_basis: every footprint BLOCK (#726): blocks sharing one reference are keyed with an ordinal suffix, so they form a pair here like any other two parts. See duplicate_references for the names the board itself uses.
assembly.oob_pad_basis: part pad AABB vs outline inflated by the grading clearance (NOT the per-pad outline measure; see render_placement checklist.a_off_outline.pad_copper)
assembly.oob_pad_copper_basis: per-PAD copper rects against the real outline at margin 0 (the authoritative measure; the same question render_placement answers in checklist.a_off_outline.pad_copper)
assembly.parts_by_side_basis: every footprint BLOCK (#726): blocks sharing one reference are keyed with an ordinal suffix and counted separately. `pad_bearing` restricts that to blocks carrying at least one pad, and it is the count the populated-side verdict is taken from -- a zero-pad graphic on the back does not make a board double-sided.
